item.title: InfiniteOreBoulder
item.description: InfiniteOreBoulder is a Resource mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Makes huge ore boulders regenerate HP so they can be mined endlessly — beware the difficulty change from infinite ore. What it does Huge ore boulders regenerate HP and can be mined forever Ends ore scarcity — beware the difficulty swing Pairs well with storage sorting mods How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe.
